title: Deep Space Tower - Roast me :)
author: enricokern
selftext:
Okay,

it is time for me to get roasted. I worked exactly like 1 1/2 day on this, it is 100% AI. 

It is kind of a Tower Defence Game, but without this static "enemys run a path" thing, instead it is a space station that is modular and enemys come out via jump windows and attack you. 

It features shields, repair bots, upgrades, a full guided tutorial, a playground to test the engine, fighter bays and god knows what.

You can download it (windows) here and test it yourself: 

[https://limewire.com/d/p7r6y#yyaxZp0nc8](https://limewire.com/d/p7r6y#yyaxZp0nc8)

Used:

\- Claude Code

Which i gave the following pipeline on my own DGX Spark for the asset generation:

\- XTTS2 (Voice Overs)

\- Flux2.klein (All Art and 2D prefabs for the 3d models)

\- MusicGen (For the Ambient Music and SFX)

\- Blender (via claude + blender headless to create 3D Models out of the flux made 2D GFX), sometimes [meshy.ai](http://meshy.ai) 

thats it, the rest is full prompt engineering.

  
Enjoy!

  
The Video is kind of sucky in 720p and also the game res was set at this, but i can do better. Check it out

comments.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
comments.body: Can you talk more about your blender MCP workflow? I've been trying to get it to make usable models and have made some progress but am not getting anything this good.

replies.author: enricokern
replies.body: I dont use mcp. I just tell claude to use blender and he interacts with it in headless mode

replies.author: enricokern
replies.body: Try a dog, base rig it and generate some anims. Meshy can only do walk for quadruplets, but the base meshy rigged glb in blender and claude can do all anims you want with it :)

comments.author: Formal-Culture-5101
comments.body:
Looks consistent: design, sound design, genre.  
The only thing is that ringtone (at 15s–16s video timeline) doesn't sound very space-related - it sounds like my phone when I need to wake up.  
  
Not a lot to roast based on the video. Maybe later will try to play.

replies.author: enricokern
replies.body: Yeah sfx needs some work, also at later waves when alot of enemies are around and you have alot of turrets it gets annoying. Short sfx generation of sub 1s audio is pain, will most likely need to source them instead of generation

replies.author: Formal-Culture-5101
replies.body: Interesting. Why are short SFX is a pain? Is it because the tuned generation length? If yes, maybe a way forward - to generate multiple sfx at once (even variations of single effect)- choose the best one and manually cut it?

replies.author: enricokern
replies.body: Good question. Most gens struggle with it, usually at the end is some none related sound. Tried multiple. At least if you want something better then a beep. I usually let claude via my apis (i have flux etc. all behind liteLLM) generate x variants and give me html where i can listen to the samples and select what i want to keep, which gives me the filenames to paste for his workflow. May try some other audio models but longer effects usually are better
